description: This PHP source file contains functions and logic for importing test cases and test suites from XML files into a test management system, including handling custom fields, requirements, keywords, and file uploads. It also defines classes and methods for managing test cases, test suites, and related entities.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Class managing test case entities, including creation, update, and retrieval.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class managing test project entities, including keyword import and requirement specifications.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Class representing a user in the test management system.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Class managing hierarchical structures like test suites and test cases.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template rendering class for the web interface.

methods.name: importTestCaseDataFromXML
methods.description: Imports test case data from an XML file into the system.

methods.name: saveImportedTCData
methods.description: Saves imported test case data into the database, handling duplicates, custom fields, and requirements.

methods.name: buildKeywordList
methods.description: Builds a list of keyword IDs from keyword names and a mapping.

methods.name: check_xml_tc_tsuite
methods.description: Checks if the uploaded XML file appears to be a valid test suite or test case XML.

methods.name: nl2p
methods.description: Converts newline characters in a string to HTML paragraph tags.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves request arguments for the import process.

methods.name: processCustomFields
methods.description: Processes custom field data for a test case, inserting values into the database.

methods.name: processRequirements
methods.description: Processes requirement data for a test case, linking or creating requirements as needed.

methods.name: importTestCasesFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Imports test cases from a SimpleXML object into the database.

methods.name: getTestCaseSetFromSimpleXMLObj
methods.description: Extracts test case data from a SimpleXML object into an array.

methods.name: getStepsFromSimpleXMLObj
methods.description: Extracts test step data from a SimpleXML object.

methods.name: getCustomFieldsFromSimpleXMLObj
methods.description: Extracts custom field data from a SimpleXML object.

methods.name: getRequirementsFromSimpleXMLObj
methods.description: Extracts requirement data from a SimpleXML object.

methods.name: getKeywordsFromSimpleXMLObj
methods.description: Extracts keyword data from a SimpleXML object.

methods.name: importTestSuitesFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Imports test suites and nested test cases from a SimpleXML object.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes GUI parameters for the import interface.

methods.name: processTestSuiteCF
methods.description: Processes custom fields for a test suite from XML data.
